description: RSP-8 fixture boot gate (ergo 23DLCY): the EXPECTED offline boot decisions of the Rust settlement-bot example (rust/examples/settlement_bot) run against the frozen degenbot-db parity.db fixture with no RPC. Shared oracle read by rust/examples/settlement_bot/tests/boot_gate.rs (Rust consumer) and tests/standalone_parity/test_settlement_bot_boot_gate.py (Python consumer, python_reachable subset). Captured from the byte-exact offline boot; a seeded divergence must fail the comparator.

env.DEGENBOT_FIXTURE_DB: <resolved at test runtime to the absolute fixture path>

python_reachable.note: The Python consumer path reaches S via degenbot._ffi.Bot.load_snapshot_from_db and the parity.db graph via degenbot._ffi.build_path_graph (chain 8453). candidate_tokens here is UNFILTERED; the Rust boot applies the 15-token ETH mainnet discovery allowlist (row 13), which is why expected.graph.candidate_tokens is 0.
